news.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls

news.title: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says
news.summary: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned BitBank, a Tehran exchange it says moved hundreds of millions of dollars in bitcoin to the Revolutionary Guards and handled payments collected from ships buying passage through the world’s most important oil chokepoint.

news.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
